definitions.explanation: The act of publishing and distributing printed works such as books or periodicals.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}を{刊行|かんこう}する。
{新|あたら}しい{辞典|じてん}が{刊行|かんこう}された。
{全集|ぜんしゅう}の{刊行|かんこう}が{完了|かんりょう}するまで、あと2{年|ねん}かかる{見込|みこ}みだ。
examples.english: It is expected to take two more years until the publication of the complete works is finished.

notes:
{刊行|かんこう} is a formal term for publishing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {刊行|かんこう}する (to publish)
- {刊行|かんこう}される (to be published)
- {刊行|かんこう}{物|ぶつ} (publication, published work)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {刊行|かんこう}: publication (formal, books)
- {出版|しゅっぱん}: publishing (general)
- {発行|はっこう}: issue, publication (periodicals, documents)

NOTE: {刊行|かんこう} is often used for books and formal publications, while {発行|はっこう} is broader.
